title: North Fulton Varsity Invitational Math Tournament
text:
The North Fulton Varsity Invitational Math Tournament is a math tournament that will first occur on Saturday, September 30, 2006. It will consist of a sixty-minute, forty-question written test, ten ciphering questions, and a proof-based team power round. Calculutors will not be permitted for any part of the competition.

The test is written primarily by students from the three schools that co-host the tournament (Alpharetta, Centennial, and North Springs High Schools).

The deadline for registration for the 2006 competition is September 22, 2006. For contact information, see the schedule of Georgia mathematics competitions.
